name: seismo-report
description: Turn seismological inputs (figures, MD, PDF, CSV/XLSX, published papers) into a chapter-wise, publication-quality interpretation report with a formal title page and MD/HTML/LaTeX-PDF/DOCX output. Honest 'Yet to be developed' policy. Skills: `seismo-report`.
